# Bloom & Rise Therapy

> Private therapy practice of Roshunda M. Hartison, MEd, LPC. In person sessions in Katy, Texas. Virtual sessions for clients who are physically in Texas, Virginia, or Colorado at the time of the session. Creative community workshops, which are educational and not therapy, are open to people in any state.

## Key facts

- Clinician: Roshunda M. Hartison, MEd, LPC. Licensed Professional Counselor in Texas (license 86566), Virginia (license 0701012957), and Colorado (license LPC.0021147).
- Education: MEd in Clinical Counseling, University of Houston Victoria. Sixteen years in mental health and community work.
- Location: in person in Katy, Texas. Virtual sessions over a secure video platform for clients in Texas, Virginia, and Colorado.
- Who she sees: individuals, couples, families, and groups, ages 15 and up.
- Focus areas: anxiety and overwhelm, identity and self-trust, body image and self-worth (weight inclusive), depression and low motivation, OCD and intrusive thoughts. Creative expression can be part of a session; she is not an art therapist.
- Approaches named on the site: cognitive behavioral therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, mindfulness, behavioral activation, and exposure and response prevention (ERP) for OCD.
- Fees: $175 for a 50 minute individual session, $200 for a couples session. A limited number of sliding scale spots.
- Insurance: in network through Headway with Aetna, Anthem, BlueCross BlueShield, Cigna and Evernorth, UnitedHealthcare and Optum, and select EAPs. Superbills for out of network.
- First step: a free 15 minute consult by video or phone, booked through the contact page.
- Contact: hello@bloomandrisetherapy.com, (346) 550 9348. Replies within two business days.
- Not a crisis service. In an emergency, call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) or call 911.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.bloomandrisetherapy.com/services): everything Roshunda works on, in one place
- [Anxiety and overwhelm](https://www.bloomandrisetherapy.com/anxiety): anxiety that looks like competence from the outside, and anxiety that makes it hard to keep up
- [Identity and self-trust](https://www.bloomandrisetherapy.com/identity): people pleasing, perfectionism, transitions, and finding your own voice again
- [Body image and self-worth](https://www.bloomandrisetherapy.com/body-image): weight inclusive work where weight loss is not a goal
- [Depression and low motivation](https://www.bloomandrisetherapy.com/depression): CBT and behavioral activation, starting small
- [OCD and intrusive thoughts](https://www.bloomandrisetherapy.com/ocd): exposure and response prevention, including harm, religious, relationship, and sexual themes
- [When words run out](https://www.bloomandrisetherapy.com/creative-therapy): creative expression in session
